PCA of untargeted urine metabolomics (ST001828, negative mode) and of
placental miRNA (GSE108497), plus a non-negative/simplex low-rank
factorisation (GLRM).

Sources: `met_classification/dim_reduction.jl` and
`met_classification/clustering_cpgs.jl`.

::: {.callout-warning}
The originals used `LowRankModels.jl` (`pca`, `qpca`, `GLRM`), which is not
installable together with current DataFrames (it requires DataFrames < 0.22).
PCA is done here with `MultivariateStats`; the GLRM section is kept for
reference and needs a separate environment with `LowRankModels`.
:::

```{julia}
using ExposomicsJulia
using DataFrames, Statistics, LinearAlgebra, Plots
using MultivariateStats
using Arrow
DATA = joinpath(pkgdir(ExposomicsJulia), ".data")
```

## ST001828 urine metabolites (negative mode)

Metabolites with ≤ 25 missing samples, median-imputed, standardised.

```{julia}
#| eval: false
df    = DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "ST001828", "covariates.arrow")));
buneg = DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "ST001828", "buneg.arrow")));
M_buneg, met_ids = omics_matrix(buneg, :metabolite, 2:101; max_missing = 25)
M10 = M_buneg[:, 1:10]

pca_buneg = fit(PCA, permutedims(M10); maxoutdim = 2)
Z = predict(pca_buneg, permutedims(M10))
scatter(Z[1, :], Z[2, :], label = "", title = "PCA ST001828 (10 metabolites)")
```

Simplex-constrained low-rank model (requires `LowRankModels`):

```{julia}
#| eval: false
using LowRankModels
simplex_pca = GLRM(M10, QuadLoss(), SimplexConstraint(), ZeroReg(), 10)
X, Y, ch = fit!(simplex_pca)
sum(X[:, 1])      # each sample's scores lie on the simplex
X' * Y
```

## GSE108497 placental miRNA

Only miRNAs without missing values.

```{julia}
#| eval: false
mirna = DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "GSE108497", "GSE108497_miRNA_norm.arrow")));
M_df, ids = omics_matrix(mirna, :ID_REF, 2:513; max_missing = 0)
pca_mirna = fit(PCA, permutedims(M_df); maxoutdim = 2)   # was LowRankModels.qpca(M_df, 2)
Zm = predict(pca_mirna, permutedims(M_df))
scatter(Zm[1, :], Zm[2, :], label = "", title = "PCA GSE108497 miRNA")
```
